supporting_observations.claim: During the alert window, WS-RDIAZ-01 repeatedly connected to 10.56.20.30:8080, the inventory's explicit proxy. Zeek classified these connections as HTTP; the records do not identify the external HTTPS destinations.
The repeated proxy connections are compatible with periodic application activity, but these records do not establish that the GradeBook Pro updater generated them or that they were malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: Per the provided sensor-coverage status, proxy, Sysmon, and WS-RDIAZ-01 Windows security logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC. This overlaps the alert window and prevents correlating the proxy connections to external destinations and endpoint processes.
The available Zeek connection records identify traffic from WS-RDIAZ-01 to the proxy, not the remote HTTPS hosts behind any proxy tunnels.
claims_not_established: Which external hostnames or URLs the alerted connections reached.
Which process initiated the repeated connections.
Whether the traffic was generated by the approved GradeBook Pro updater or another application.
Whether any data was sent to an unauthorized service or the activity was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, user-agent, byte counts, and any inspected request details.
Recover WS-RDIAZ-01 endpoint process and network telemetry for the alert window to attribute the connections to a process.
Verify whether GradeBook Pro updater activity occurred on WS-RDIAZ-01 during the alert window and compare its destination and timing with the recovered proxy records.
unrelated_findings: WS-THART-01 launched msra.exe targeting WS-RDIAZ-01, and the records show Tess Hart supplying Raul Diaz credentials followed by a network logon from WS-RDIAZ-01 to WS-THART-01. This warrants separate review against the stated remote-administration practices; the records do not establish that a remote-assistance session completed. (T275-00050, T275-00051, T275-00053, T275-00066, T275-00067)

WS-RDIAZ-01 made a proxy connection to updates.paloaltonetworks.com using the GlobalProtect user-agent. Given the inventory says there is no VPN, review separately; this record alone does not establish VPN use or relate it to the alerted periodic connections. (T275-00357)
